Where the data comes from

University and department details come from NIIED's 2026 GKS-G files. Professor details come from each university's own faculty pages, and every list links to its source. New professors are added regularly.

Always check the official call

The 2027 GKS-G guidelines may change the rules. Confirm deadlines and requirements on Study in Korea before you apply.
